source_game: Zillion II: The Tri Formation (Sega Master System)
source_boundary: Weapon identity and move concepts use Master System game evidence only. At the owner's request, anime references inform costume construction in the visual concept only; they do not define moves, lore, or palette.
principles: Keep shots single-hit until the project's multi-hit rule is decided.
Preserve recovery windows so the Zillion Laser can be approached or guarded against.
Treat Armorater movement as a brief, telegraphed repositioning action, not a permanent form change.
Do not assign frame data, damage, invulnerability, or projectile speed before the character is reviewed and measured.
basic_attack_direction: quick Zillion pistol butt strike at point blank

specials.name: Disparo Zillion
specials.source_basis: J.J.'s laser weapon is part of the Master System game depiction and equipment identity.
specials.concept: One straight, clearly telegraphed laser shot for mid-range control.

specials.name: Evasão Armorater
specials.source_basis: The Japanese package description says J.J.'s buggy can change into Armorater; see SMS Power scan.
specials.concept: A brief, telegraphed upward displacement using Armorater propulsion, then an immediate return to the normal J.J. silhouette.

open_questions: Does Armorater appear as a complete transformation, a short boost, or stay outside the playable moveset?
Should the Zillion Laser be a projectile that can be guarded, or a short-range ray with a different counter window?
Confirm light class and 72–76 px height through the project scale pilot.
